name: freecad
summary: Parametric 3D CAD platform for scripted design generation, engineering geometry, and manufacturing exports.
why_it_matters: FreeCAD captures useful open CAD capability knowledge, but current support is too shallow and unused to justify maintaining it as a supported resource today.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs programmatic CAD generation.
Operators need open-source parametric design tools in automation workflows.
The workflow depends on geometry export for manufacturing or simulation.

platform_support.notes: FreeCAD is cross-platform, but Python API behavior, GUI automation, and package quality vary by host environment.

prerequisites: Defined scripting and export workflow boundaries
Artifact storage conventions for generated models
implementation_notes: Promotion should focus on a few validated CAD automation workflows rather than broad wrapper coverage.
GUI and headless usage need separate support assumptions.
Keep geometry generation and downstream manufacturing/export concerns distinct.
operational_notes: Version drift can break workbenches and scripted exports.
Health checks should validate a minimal scripted CAD job.
Desktop and headless usage have different failure modes.
risks: CAD automation is deeper than basic lifecycle support suggests.
Cross-platform scripting reliability is easy to overclaim.
